findings.text: the Measure paragraph cites the sibling module's over-bound figure as "reckon/ledger.py (52,989 tokens)", but 52,989 is review.py's base figure and ledger.py measures 51,666 (negative-control.log, and my own width-test run at deb49233c), so the fragment misreports the one sibling figure a reader would carry forward.

the done-when requires the manifest to record both modules' estimated tokens at head, but the manifest's artifacts and landing fields carry only review.py's 41,357, leaving review_records.py's 12,512 only in the cited fragment.

raw_text:
VERDICT goal: the source goal is to move the committed review-record store family out of reckon/crew/review.py into reckon/crew/review_records.py so review.py fits the worker-window bound; reckon/crew/review_records.py:1 carries the family and reckon/crew/review.py:3179 re-exports ten names, and I measured review.py at 41,357 tokens and review_records.py at 12,512 by reckon.crew.routing._tokens_for_bytes at deb49233c.
VERDICT done_when: the done_when names the two-arm population gate, both module bounds, the negative control and ruff; the manifest records gate-base.log (5 failed) and gate-head2.log (5 failed, same ids, zero added) and the fragment records both token figures, though the manifest itself carries only review.py's 41,357 and not review_records.py's 12,512.
VERDICT write_paths: read the manifest's declared paths (reckon/crew/review.py, reckon/crew/review_records.py, three test files, the evidence fragment, a figures dir); the diff touches review.py, review_records.py, two tests under tests/ and the fragment, so every changed path is inside them.
VERDICT manifest: read; it states the two-arm suite result (base 5 failed / head 5 failed with identical ids), attributes the sub-floor setup ERROR as scaffolding with five alone-run logs, records the negative control, the landing line and both gate commands.
VERDICT diff: read the three commits against base c66a1ced9 -- e392f4cd9 moves the family and re-exports it (944 lines out of review.py, 979 into review_records.py), e6a43d618 corrects patch semantics by reading shared names through the review module at call time, deb49233c adds the 58-line evidence fragment; review_records.py imports only `review as _review`, so no shared name stays a module local.
CALL_SITES: reckon/crew/promotion.py:1650 store_committed_review, reckon/crew/promotion_checks.py:637 stored_record, reckon/crew/obligations.py:1145 stored_records_for_run, reckon/crew/obligation_snapshot.py:963 collect_read_failures
SCORE goal_fidelity: 19
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/review_records.py:1 holds the store family and reckon/crew/review.py:3179 re-exports it, with review.py measuring 41,357 tokens against the plan's 45,000 bound at deb49233c.
SCORE evidence: 15
JUSTIFICATION evidence: gate-head2.log records the head arm at 5 failed/1121 passed and I ran the width test at deb49233c, which names only reckon/ledger.py (51,666), but the manifest's own fields carry review.py's 41,357 and omit review_records.py's 12,512.
SCORE scope_discipline: 19
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: the three commits touch only reckon/crew/review.py, reckon/crew/review_records.py, the two tests whose patch target moved and the landing fragment, all inside the declared write paths.
SCORE durability: 17
JUSTIFICATION durability: I ran tests/test_every_module_fits_a_worker_window.py at deb49233c and it names only ledger.py, and negative-control.log shows restoring review.py reddens it naming review.py: 52989, so the bound guard fires; the patch-semantics fix rests on tests/test_a_review_with_no_base_is_not_carried.py:94 patching review_store_root.
SCORE fit: 18
JUSTIFICATION fit: reckon/crew/review_records.py:1 follows the package idiom with a module docstring and a foot-of-module import to break the cycle, and carries no plan, ticket or version identifier.
SCORE reuse: 20
JUSTIFICATION reuse: the new module extends the owner rather than duplicating it -- reckon/crew/review.py:3179 re-exports the same ten names -- and a capability search across reckon/crew found no second review-record store.
